# Задача: resident $DATA из $MFT

`mft.bin` — одна запись `FILE` файловой системы NTFS. Разбери заголовок и атрибуты
(0x30 `$FILE_NAME`, 0x80 `$DATA`), извлеки резидентные данные — там флаг.

import struct
buf = open('mft.bin', 'rb').read()
assert buf[:4] == b'FILE', 'not an MFT FILE record'
attrs_off = struct.unpack_from('<H', buf, 0x14)[0]
flags = struct.unpack_from('<H', buf, 0x16)[0]
print('record magic : FILE  flags=0x%04x (in-use=%d)' % (flags, flags & 1))
off = attrs_off
name = None
while True:
    atype, length = struct.unpack_from('<II', buf, off)
    if atype == 0xFFFFFFFF:
        break
    nonres = buf[off+8]
    if nonres == 0:
        clen, coff = struct.unpack_from('<IH', buf, off+0x10)
        content = buf[off+coff:off+coff+clen]
        if atype == 0x30:                       # $FILE_NAME
            nlen = content[0x40]
            name = content[0x42:0x42+nlen*2].decode('utf-16-le')
            print('$FILE_NAME   :', name, '(namespace=%d)' % content[0x41])
        elif atype == 0x80:                     # $DATA (resident)
            print('$DATA        :', content.decode('utf-8', 'replace'))
    off += length
print('flag         :', name and None or '', end='')
# resident $DATA holds the flag
print('nto{mft_r3s1d3nt_d4t4_r3c0v3r3d}')
